status: Three native suffix adapters trained and rejected; all32 temporal/text-head run07 training locally after padded-window memory gates.
reason: PersonaPlex role conditioning is well matched to the desired experience, but official Moshi LoRA training is directly documented. Do not assume checkpoint interchangeability without a strict weight/config compatibility test.
data_steps: Render each user/Jun turn with explicitly licensed synthetic voices, keeping Jun's voice fixed and user voices diverse.
Quality-check speech against transcript and reject silence, truncation, clipping and major transcription errors.
Convert renders to mono PCM16 24 kHz. Supply turn WAV paths and explicit gaps/overlaps to scripts/stitch_duplex.py.
Keep split assignments from text conversations. Output left channel Jun, right channel user.
Run official annotate.py to generate actual word-timestamp annotations. Turn-level provenance is not a substitute.
Inspect both waveform channels and timestamp coverage before training. Include interruption, backchannel and long-pause cases, not only alternating turns.
memory_caveat: These are measurements for the example recipe, not a theoretical minimum. Lower batch size may help; shorter audio context can degrade conversational persistence. No CUDA device is available locally.
required_speech_acceptance: Saved speech checkpoint loads in the native streaming inference implementation.
Held-out spoken character conversations show consistent Jun identity and adequate intelligibility.
Measure response latency and interruption stop latency separately, using audio timestamps.
Compare pause, interruption and backchannel behavior to the exact pretrained checkpoint on fixed Full-Duplex-Bench cases.
Measure realtime factor and peak memory on the intended inference device; do not substitute published H100 latency for local performance.
hardware_constraint: User requires all training and inference on this 8 GB Apple M2 Mac. No cloud or external GPU.

mac_experiment.hypothesis: Frozen quantized weights, precomputed Mimi codes, short sequences, small LoRA adapters may fit; unverified until actual memory and training tests.
mac_experiment.implementation: Official moshi_mlx inference needs a causal teacher-forced training forward; verify against tokenwise streaming outputs before training.
mac_experiment.status: Actual native generation, three suffix training runs, and active all-layer training
mac_experiment.strategy: All32 temporal output/MLP adapters plus text head, rank8 scale2. Sixteen-frame truncated BPTT with full carried forward attention and optimizer disk offload. Final short window padded with masked targets.
mac_experiment.earlier_strategy: Cache frozen embeddings and first 28 temporal layers; unload them; train four-layer suffix LoRA and text head using joint text/audio CE; export adapter names back to the complete native streaming model.

training_recipe_scope: Published upstream reference recipe only; not the recipe run on this Mac.

completed_speech_audits.scope: Six custom development probes. These are not Full-Duplex-Bench scores. Fixed overlap trials can be inconclusive.

external_benchmark_status: Official Full-Duplex-Bench source/data access being inspected. No local Full-Duplex-Bench measurement completed.
